scope: Per-token supervision and trajectory-level zero-update verification of COMPLETE uncertainty replies on the DG-019/020/021 panel's four ground-truth insufficient records. Teacher tokens may extend only past prefixes; every label is read by loss after a label-free branch forward. Preserve DG-019 through DG-021 code, weights and reports unchanged.
supervision: Compile route-2 teacher trajectories with the unchanged DG-019 oracle compiler (all GENERATE phases, explicit EOS final, exact full reply bytes, no truncation, prompt+completion<=128, completion<=64 wrapper budget). At every position the query-only branch runs on the fresh C frame of exactly prompt+targets[:i]. Per-token CE including the EOS position; per-trajectory sum, equal-weight mean across the four records. Route-0 and route-1 records are never supervised by the uncertainty branch; the module rejects non-uncertainty route targets.
native_gate: Batch-extract every unique uncertainty-trajectory prefix and the four normal records' reference positions {0, len//2, len-1} with the frozen memory_prefix_probe (fresh context per prefix, disclosed one-prefill internal K/V work buffers, no cross-prefix reuse). Direct frozen memory_gradient_reference cross-check at first/middle/final position of each uncertainty trajectory and at position 0 of each normal record; bitwise hidden/logits equality required. Zero-residual frozen memory_continuous_probe parity at position 0 of the two non-fixture uncertainty records.
gradient_gate: Zero-initialized branch: aggregate backward over all 50 positions gives finite nonzero output.weight gradient and exactly-zero encoder weight/bias gradients (expected chain rule at Wout=0, not frozen learning). Fixture branch (0.001*identity output, separate copy) connects both layers across whole trajectories. Trajectory-partial native finite difference on each fixture trajectory at its three reference positions: objective is the partial teacher-target CE (a calculus fixture on the supervision objective, not answer accuracy), per-position residual gradients, combined unit-norm direction, epsilon 0.01, atol 0.0005, rtol 0.02 vs autograd; enabled-nonzero C/Python parity (atol 1e-5, rtol 1e-4, same top-1) and disabled-nonzero base-bit identity at the same three positions.
normal_bypass_gate: Recompute the untrained reader's own route prediction on each normal record's actual initial C frame: the wrong insufficient routing is preserved verbatim as a kept real failure, not masked, relabeled or retrained. Disabled and zero-residual enabled branch outputs at every normal reference frame must equal base logits bitwise. No normal position enters uncertainty supervision.
copy_exclusion_gate: Supported records compile with exactly one START and one END and are excluded from uncertainty supervision by construction and by explicit assertion; the archived DG-019/DG-020/DG-021 reports and their recorded source hashes must verify unchanged before and after this round.
limits: No optimizer step, weight update or checkpoint; no free generation, no token commits, no semantic scoring, HTTP serving or LoCoMo. Controller handoff is reproduced only as the position-0 anchor under DG-022 identity; teacher-forced positions 1..n-1 are module-level forwards because controller commits acknowledge only real emissions. Budget or capacity violations are explicit failures, never truncation. Query-only provenance remains an interface property, not refusal competence.
